list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation; guides written for this entry

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then side missions, then activities, then cleanup. It is the last trophy you will hear, by definition.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work through the four roadmap stages in this guide.
Use the checklist here to track the 54 others.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission: Lucia is out of prison and back in Leonida, and the job with Jason goes sideways almost immediately. Play through it — the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. No special conditions, no time limit.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 1 sets up Lucia and Jason's return to Vice City and ends once its final mission is done. Just keep playing the story missions in order — side content can wait. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable trophy in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 2 pushes the crew deeper into Leonida's drug trade and the jobs get bigger and messier. Finish its last story mission and the chapter — and the trophy — are done. Nothing here can be missed, so just enjoy the ride.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 3 is Vice City proper — the neon, the beachfront, the big scores. Work through its missions in order; the trophy lands when the chapter's final mission wraps. By now your wanted level and your wallet should both be climbing nicely.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 4 is the climb to the top of Leonida's criminal ladder, and it ends with the crew at their highest — and most exposed. Clear its missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter close, setting up the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the gold one that closes the campaign. The final mission is the payoff for everything Lucia and Jason built — and everything it cost them. Finish it and the credits roll with this trophy in your pocket. After the story, free roam stays open for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4.
Play the final mission to its end.
The gold trophy unlocks when the story completes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Breakfast Run is an early story mission that tests whether Lucia and Jason can actually trust each other when a simple job goes wrong. Play it as part of the story — it unlocks in order, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Progress the story until Breakfast Run unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set pieces — a planned hit on cartel money that, like every plan in Leonida, does not go as drawn up. It arrives in story order; finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Child's Play is a story mission about the family ties that keep pulling Lucia and Jason back into trouble. It unlocks in story order — play it through and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Progress the story until Child's Play unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Headliners is a loud, public story mission — the kind that puts Lucia and Jason on every news screen in Leonida. It comes in story order; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Progress the story until Headliners unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. VCIA Takedown takes the action to Vice City International Airport — a hijack on the tarmac with the whole airport as the playground. It unlocks in story order; complete the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Progress the story until VCIA Takedown unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Operation Savage Glory is a late-story military-scale mission — the biggest firefight the campaign throws at you. It arrives in story order; survive it to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Progress the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The gold for doing literally everything. 100% completion counts the story, all side missions and stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the big grinds — the game's own checklist tracks it in the stats menu. Leave this for last: it pops on its own once every other requirement is met, so use this guide's checklist as your map and tick things off stage by stage.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and all side-mission strands.
Clear the activities, collectibles and grind trophies.
Check the in-game stats menu for the 100% tracker.
The gold pops the moment the counter hits 100%.

trophies.guide: A stunt is any show-off driving move the game scores: jumps, near misses, long airtime, drifting through traffic. They add up fast during normal play, but 250 is a grind — the quickest farm is the airport runways and long highway stretches, chaining jumps off ramps and near-misses in traffic. Any vehicle counts, and the counter never resets. Each scored move counts once, so one fast drive through traffic can bank several stunts — chip away at it whenever you drive.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and recklessly — jumps and near misses count as stunts.
Farm the airport runways and highway ramps for repeated jumps.
Watch the counter in the stats menu; 250 total is the target.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida has 9 activity types and this trophy just wants a taste of each one: fishing, bowling, arcade games, Top Fun drone races, the Shooting Range, street races, and the rest. You do not need to win or finish anything — starting each activity once is enough. The fastest route is a tour of Vice City in one session: fish at the pier, bowl a frame, play one arcade cabinet, enter one drone race, fire one range challenge, and join one street race.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try one of each — winning is not required.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across Leonida's ranges, and every one needs a gold medal — not just a pass. Each challenge sets a score and time target for a weapon class: pistols, rifles, shotguns and more. Go slow and steady on the precision drills, and use the range's own practice runs to learn each course before going for gold. The range menu shows which challenges are still missing gold, so work through the list one weapon at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list (42 total).
Learn each course in a practice run first.
Earn gold on every challenge — the range menu tracks golds.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations around Leonida, and you need a win at each one. The drones handle like quick, twitchy aircraft — brake early into the gates, cut corners tight, and learn each course's gate order before pushing for the win. Losing is free, so retry a course until the racing line clicks; the race menu marks which locations you have already won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race (14 locations on the map).
Learn the gate order with a slow first lap.
Win at all 14 locations — the menu tracks your wins.

trophies.guide: Twenty different race events, twenty wins. Street races, boat races and air races all count as long as each event is a different one — replaying the same race does not add to the total. Race markers appear across Leonida as you explore; take the fastest vehicle you own for each type, and use slipstreams on the long straights. The race menu shows which events you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race markers across Leonida (street, boat and air).
Win 20 different events — repeats do not count.
Track won events in the race menu.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the local fishing rival — he challenges you at the fishing spots, and beating him takes more than luck. Match the lure to the water (the fishing menu hints at what bites where), cast near the ripples, and keep the line tension in the green while reeling: too much tension snaps it, too little lets the fish off. Land a bigger catch than Cal's and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Go fishing and accept Cal's challenge.
Match lure to the spot and keep line tension in the green.
Out-fish Cal to take the trophy.

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade in Vice City, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end — a high score is not needed, just a finished game. The cabinets are the classic kind: shooters, racers and rhythm games. One full playthrough of any single game pops the trophy, so pick the shortest one you like.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Enter an arcade in Vice City.
Pick any cabinet and play it to the end.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with a full mission strand — a fixer trying to go straight, with mixed results. His missions unlock as the story progresses; take each one as it appears, and the strand ends with his final mission. Finish it and the trophy pops. Side strands are never missable, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's missions as they unlock during the story.
Play through his strand to the final mission.
Complete the final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton runs boats — smuggling, racing, and whatever pays — and his strand ends on the water. His missions appear as the story moves along; work through them in order until the final one. The last mission is a boat job with a twist in its tail, and finishing it pops the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they unlock during the story.
Play through his strand to the final mission.
Complete the final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is a biker with a lone-wolf streak, and his strand is all bikes, highways and bad decisions. His missions unlock through the story; ride each one out until the final mission. Finish it and the trophy pops — and you will have a very good bike by then, too.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's missions as they unlock during the story.
Play through his strand to the final mission.
Complete the final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers show up as question-mark icons across Leonida — odd characters with odd jobs, from conspiracy theorists to washed-up celebrities. Each one has a short strand of missions, and you need 8 strands finished in full. There are more than 8 strangers in the state, so pick the ones whose missions you enjoy; the map marks them, and a strand counts only when its last mission is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger icons (?) on the map across Leonida.
Play a strand's missions to the end — 8 strands total.
The silver pops when the eighth strand completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is a supplier — the man who knows where everything in Leonida comes from, and what it costs. His strand is a chain of supply runs that get hotter each time, ending in a final mission where the supply line itself is the prize. Take his missions as they unlock and finish the last one for the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's missions as they unlock during the story.
Play through his strand to the final mission.
Complete the final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is pure Vice City nightlife — clubs, DJs and the business behind the music. His missions unlock as the story progresses, and the strand builds to a final mission that spins the whole operation on its head. Play his missions in order and finish the last one for the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they unlock during the story.
Play through his strand to the final mission.
Complete the final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before you finish Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida: beaches, hilltops, rooftops, quiet corners. Sit at each one and meditate to count it. One spot sits on a Chapter 1 balcony, and guides list it as missable: meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, or the set can never be completed on that playthrough. Do the balcony spot the moment you can, then collect the other 17 at your leisure.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: MISSABLE: meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before the chapter ends.
Find the other 17 meditation spots across Leonida (18 total).
Meditate at each — the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is Leonida's hunting contact, and he wants one specific animal — a unique beast that only appears in one place, at one time of day. Track it with the hunting senses, approach downwind so it does not bolt, and take a clean shot: a messy kill can fail the hunt. If it gets away, leave the area and come back later for another chance.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunting mission when it unlocks.
Track the unique animal to its hunting ground.
Take a clean shot — a bad kill fails the hunt, but you can retry.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, on rooftops, in glove boxes, behind counters. Each set needs every card in it, and you need 3 full sets for the silver. The collection menu shows which cards you own and which sets are close, so hunt the missing ones last. Cards never disappear, so this is pure cleanup work.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up cards as you explore — the menu tracks each set.
Use the collection menu to find which cards are missing.
Complete any 3 full sets for the silver.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is Leonida's tagging game: spray the WAiNK mark at marked spots — walls, billboards, underpasses — and each one counts. You need 100 tagged spots. The map marks tagged spots once found, and the counter in the stats menu shows your total. It is a long grind best done while exploring for other collectibles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Find WAiNK It spots (marked walls and billboards).
Spray the mark at 100 different locations.
The stats menu tracks your total.

trophies.guide: The challenges menu is a long list of small feats — stunt counts, kill counts, driving feats, exploration goals — and you need 50 of them done. Many complete themselves during normal play and the story, so check the menu after the campaign: you will likely be halfway there. Then pick the easy ones left — low-count stunts and driving challenges — and grind the last few deliberately.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges menu and see what is already done.
Play the story and activities — many complete on their own.
Target the easiest remaining challenges until 50 are done.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this with your partner beside you — the story missions where Lucia and Jason work as a pair are the natural moment. Rack up a 4-star wanted level (rob a store, cause chaos, let the heat build), then break line of sight: duck into an alley, swap cars, hide until the stars flash and clear. It must be a full escape with your partner present, not a busted or wasted ending.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play a story mission with your partner alongside.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops, one wanted level, no breaks. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, then drive straight to the next and rob it while the cops are still chasing — the wanted level must stay alive across all three. Do not get busted or wasted between robberies, and do not let the heat die down: keep moving, keep robbing, and use a fast car with a planned route through three nearby shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Plan a route past three shops close together.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then drive on immediately.
Rob shops two and three without losing the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Every new vehicle model you sit in for the first time counts as discovered — cars, bikes, boats, planes, the lot. Leonida is full of them: traffic, parking lots, docks, airfields. The vehicle list in the menu shows what you have found, and the total climbs fast if you hop into something different every time you see it. One hundred sounds like a lot, but a curious driver hits it long before the platinum.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Sit in every new vehicle model you see.
Check the vehicle list to see what is still missing.
100 different models discovered pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim mode — activate it and time crawls while you line up shots. The trick is the setup: find a gang shootout or a group of enemies bunched together, wait until five are in view, then trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before the meter runs out. A rifle with a big magazine helps, and the meter refills, so if you only get four, reset and try the next group.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus with all five in view.
Down all five before the meter empties.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The best reading of the description is a takeoff from Vice City International Airport outside the scheduled flights: steal a plane on the tarmac and get airborne while the airport is on alert, instead of following any mission's flight plan. Try it in free roam with a fast plane and a clear runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam.
Steal a plane and take off without following a mission plan.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — try different aircraft and runways.

trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The description points at the Rhino tank: the likely path is stealing one from the military base and surviving the response it draws, or taking one down. Try both: grab a Rhino and cause chaos with it, and separately try destroying one. One of the two is almost certainly the trigger.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Head to the military base in free roam.
Steal a Rhino tank — or destroy one.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — try both approaches.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store at night, when the staff is thin and the street is quiet. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you — a silenced weapon or a melee takedown on the guard, smash the cases fast, and walk out before anyone raises the alarm. If a guard spots you or the alarm trips, leave and try another store; detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Choose a jewelry store at night.
Enter quietly — no alarms, no witnesses.
Smash the cases and leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, five clean escapes. Vault jobs are the heavy end of robbery: crack the vault, grab the cash, and lose the cops before the heat peaks. Plan each getaway before you go in — a fast car parked close, a route away from the main roads — and do not linger for extra loot once the alarm is up. Five successful vault robberies with an escape each earns the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Pick a bank and park a fast getaway car nearby.
Crack the vault and grab the cash.
Escape cleanly — repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes on Leonida's highways — watch for one, then block it in traffic and crack it open. The classic blitz: ram it to a stop, deal with the guards, blow or pry the rear doors, grab the cash and vanish before backup arrives. One truck, one clean escape, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on a highway route.
Ram it to a stop and crack the rear doors.
Grab the cash and escape cleanly.

trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 named areas, from Vice City's beachfront to the swamps and the Keys, and you need to set foot in all of them. The map fills in as you travel, so this is mostly a matter of driving everywhere — take the long way on missions, detour down every road, and check the map for dark patches. The last few are usually the remote corners: the far swamp, the outer islands, the mountain roads.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive everywhere — the map reveals areas as you visit them.
Check the map for dark, unvisited patches.
Visit all 52 named areas for the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run Leonida's underworld, and each one runs at least one illegal operation — a stash house, a chop shop, a lab, a warehouse. Find one operation per gang, rob it, and move on to the next gang's turf. The operations show up as you explore gang territory and take their side content; the trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation in each gang's territory (9 gangs).
Rob one operation per gang.
The trophy pops at the ninth gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The description is a scene, not a checklist: a cocktail, a view, Ocean Beach. The best bet is a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive — order a drink, sit with the ocean in front of you, and let the scene play. Try it at sunset, when the bars are busiest, and try more than one beachfront spot if the first does not pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — try at sunset and at different bars.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The description is a classic GTA movie moment: a car smashing out through a showroom's glass front. The likely path is stealing a car from a high-end dealership in Vice City and driving it straight out through the window. Try the big showrooms, build speed inside, and aim for the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Get in a car and drive out through the glass front.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — try different showrooms.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kolt & Associates runs the bowling alley in Vice City, and this trophy is about the follow-through — playing a full game, not just throwing one ball. Rent a lane, bowl your frames, and finish the game. It does not matter if you win or lose, or what you score; a completed game at that alley is what counts.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Rent a lane and bowl a full game.
The trophy pops when the game finishes.

trophies.guide: This one is tied to Lucia and Jason as a partnership — the duo's rising profile across Leonida. The description is deliberately vague, but guides tie it to the story's partnership arc: keep playing story and side content with your partner, build the duo's reputation, and it pops at the beat the game marks as their breakout moment. If it has not popped by the end of the story, work through the remaining side strands.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story and side strands with your partner.
Build the partnership through shared missions.
The trophy pops at the partnership's breakout beat.

trophies.guide: Every choice counts — literally. PlayStation tracks a count of the decisions you make, up to 500: dialogue choices, mission approach choices, the small moral calls scattered through the story and side content. There is no way to farm this quickly; it accumulates as you play everything. Just keep making choices — pick dialogue options instead of skipping them — and the counter climbs to 500 on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue included.
Play story, side missions and stranger strands.
The trophy pops when the counter reaches 500 choices.

trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The description says it plainly, though: second time's the charm. The likely trigger is failing something and then succeeding on the immediate retry — a mission, a challenge, a race. If a mission goes wrong, do not reload an old save: retry it straight away and finish it on the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission, challenge or race.
Retry it immediately — do not reload an old save.
Succeed on the second attempt for the trophy.

trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The description is a reaction, not an instruction: something strange happens, and you were there for it. Leonida is full of strange-phenomenon spots — the swamps, the desert roads, the night sky. Visit the odd locations late at night, look up, and wait for something that should not be there.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Visit strange-phenomenon spots around Leonida at night.
Look to the skies and the swamps.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — the event is rare, so keep checking.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: HONEST NOTE: the exact trigger for this one is not confirmed yet — no guide has pinned it down before release. The name and description point at bowling pins and a melee attack from a moving vehicle: knock people down like pins with a melee weapon while driving past. The bowling alley area is the natural place to try it — cruise past a group on the sidewalk with a bat in hand and swing as you pass. The name suggests ten knockdowns in one pass — aim for ten.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a group of pedestrians and swing as you pass.
Exact trigger unconfirmed — aim for ten knockdowns in one pass.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Heists pay in Marked Bills — dirty money you cannot spend directly. Your contacts launder it for a cut: hand the bills over through the contacts menu and clean cash comes back. You need $250,000 laundered in total, which takes several big heists. Do not rush it — the total accumulates across the whole game, and the late-story heists pay the biggest stacks of marked bills.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
$250,000 laundered in total pops the trophy.

trophies.guide: One hundred thousand dollars across every shop in Leonida: clothes, weapons, car mods, food, property extras — all of it counts. This one takes care of itself if you play normally and buy the good gear, but the fastest way is the expensive stuff: a high-end car and a full mod job, or a wardrobe refresh at the designer stores. The spending counter in the stats menu shows your total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes, weapons and car mods as you play.
Big-ticket items (cars, full mods) move the total fastest.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, and you need all of them. They are not cheap — save your money through the story, launder your marked bills, and buy garages as you can afford them. Each one also stores your vehicles, so they pay for themselves in convenience. The property menu shows which garages you own and which are still for sale.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Save money through the story and laundering.
Buy each of the 8 garage properties.
The trophy pops when the last garage is bought.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is Leonida's vehicle app — register a vehicle to it and it is yours on demand. Steal or buy ten different vehicles, open the app for each one and register it. Any ten count, so grab the easy ones first: street cars, parked bikes, a boat at the docks. The app shows how many you have registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Steal or buy a vehicle.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Register 10 vehicles for the trophy.
